paint-nose.summary: Paint the cow's rounded muzzle tucked under the fringe.
paint-nose.tip: Shape the nose as a rounded muzzle about 2 1/2 in tall, its middle about 7 1/4 in from the left edge and 8 1/2 in from the top edge, peeking out from under the fringe as the Where picture shows. Keep it a flat, soft pinkish brown with no highlight, nostrils or mouth yet; let the shaggy coat overlap its top edge so it sits under the hair.

nose-shine.summary: Lay a pale pink band of light across the top of the nose.
nose-shine.tip: The light comes from the low sun at the right, behind the cow, so the pale pink stays on the top of the nose only, where the after picture has it: its top is about 7 1/2 in from the top edge, and it's about 1 1/4 in wide and 3/4 in tall. Curve the short strokes over the rounded top and keep the Rosy nose showing around these strokes, as the after picture shows, so the nose still reads as round.

nostrils-mouth.summary: Line two dark nostrils and a gently wobbling mouth under the nose.
nostrils-mouth.tip: Paint the two nostrils first, as small commas at the bottom of the nose where the after picture has them, then the mouth line under the nose. Keep both thin so the Nose pink top and the Rosy nose stay showing. The after picture also turns the whole nose a slightly greyer pink with a darker shadow under the mouth; if yours looks too bright, a thin touch of Dark umber softened under the mouth gets you close.
